name: Till The End of The Moon
description: In an era when the demons are in power, they are the masters of the despicable cultivators and mortals. The cultivator elders deem it necessary to send someone back in time to determine the origin of the demon lord and to prevent his awakening. Li Susu accepts the mission, becoming the mortal Ye Xiwu, General Ye's third daughter, who is married to Tantai Jin, the hostage prince and future demon lord. She is determined to destroy Tantai Jin, who, in the future, will massacre many. But as a witness to Tantai Jin's past life and rise to power, an unexpected tale emerges, one complicating her quest.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A powerful demon lord pushes the world to the brink of destruction. To reverse this fate, a desperate Li Susu stumbles upon a dangerous opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Under the identity of Ye Xiwu, Susu uncovers details about her past life. However, the Tantai Jin from 500 years ago is nothing like she imagined.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While keeping tabs on Tantai Jin, Susu sends him a heartwarming gift. Later, a demon who preys on nightmares edges closer to a special victim.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Trapped in a mysterious realm, Li Susu revisits Tantai Jin's tragic past. A weakness of Tantai Jin places him in dire danger.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The discovery of a deadly power leads Tantai Jin to rethink his life. Soon after, he executes a plan of revenge on a big wedding day.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After striking a deal with each other, Tantai Jin begins learning incantations from Ye Xiwu. Ye Qingyu's return causes a stir in the Ye family.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Faced with danger, Tantai Jin plots a grand escape from the Ye family. Ye Qingyu's late-night visit to Pianran leads to unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Ye Xiwu tries to escape from a hostage situation. Meanwhile, Tantai Jin continues with his revenge plan but soon faces a gut-wrenching betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Tantai Minglang vows to hunt down his fugitive half-brother. After surviving their own fatal accident, Ye Xiwu and Tantai Jin's paths cross again.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After saving Pianran's life, Xiwu asks for a favor in return. Tantai Jin's newfound power puts a strain on the fragile relations between two nations.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Ye Qingyu faces a difficult decision between loyalty and integrity. Tantai Jin's attempt to awaken a powerful being unleashes massive chaos.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: To save her crush, Sang Jiu makes an impulsive choice that endangers her family. Mingye finds himself in a reluctant marriage arrangement.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sang Jiu adapts to her new life in the realm of the gods as she grows closer to Mingye. However, Tianhuan becomes jealous of their connection.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Concerns mount over a powerful demon's plan to destroy the world. Planning to go on a suicide mission, Mingye decides to part ways with Sang Jiu.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: During an epic battle against a fearsome demon, the gods must make ultimate sacrifices. Soon after, Sang Jiu sets out to search for the missing Mingye.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A wounded Mingye finds warmth and friendship in his mysterious caretaker. Tianhuan's jealousy drives her to make a cruel move.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Sang Jiu decides to harness the power of demons to avenge her family, which results in a series of disastrous consequences.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: To revive her family, Sang Jiu summons a cursed power against warning. After awakening from a dream, Xiwu takes a new step to accomplish her mission.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After her family reunion, Xiwu shows her gratitude to Tantai Jin. But her plan to win his heart proves to be more difficult than she expected.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Ye Xiwu and Tantai Jin find a chance to enjoy a memorable evening together. Meanwhile, Xiao Lin faces mounting pressure to quickly defeat his enemy.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Hoping to eliminate his opponent, Emperor Sheng resorts to an ominous plan. After a fatal night, a clash erupts between Tantai Jin and Ye Xiwu.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Careful calculations lead Bingchang to approach Tantai Jin, and soon after, a shocking revelation prompts Xiwu to reevaluate her judgment of him.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ye Xiwu and Tantai Jin spend an unforgettable Qixi night together. To prove her worth, Ye Bingchang sets up a trap for a beloved one.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Ye Bingchang receives punishment after a hidden history is unveiled before everyone. Later, Qingyu tries to console a heartbroken Pianran.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Tantai Jin devises a plan of revenge after noticing Ye Xiwu's effort to rescue Xiao Lin. A devastating tragedy rocks the Ye family.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: After returning to Tantai Jin's side, Xiwu poses a big question to him. Now, her plan of destroying the demon lord hinges on a special day.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: As Xiwu's life hangs in the balance, Tantai Jin strikes a deal with Pang Yizhi. Meanwhile, Tantai Minglang's demon army poses a daunting new challenge.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Tantai Minglang's invasion leads to a brutal bloodbath. Bracing for a deadly curse, Xiwu reveals the shocking truth behind Tantai Jin's tragic destiny.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Qingyu confronts Bingchang about her plot against Xiwu. Later, a devastated Tantai Jin finds a glint of hope and sets out on a perilous quest for love.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Back in the present, Susu grapples with the new world without the demon lord. Meanwhile, Tantai Jin's search for Xiwu leads him to the Xiaoyao Sect.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Joining Xiaoyao Sect as Cang Jiumin, Tantai Jin presses on in his quest to resurrect Xiwu. A major contest among rival sects is infiltrated by demons.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: A reunion between two estranged lovers ends in heartbreak. Following the unsealing of a magic talisman, several shocking revelations begin to surface.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Cang Jiumin tries to find a way to escape his cursed fate. With the help of two friends, Susu's solo trip turns into a demon-slaying adventure.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Cang Jiumin's clash with two demons causes a massive misunderstanding, and all mayhem breaks loose as his secrets are exposed in public.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Waking from a coma, Susu rushes to the rescue of Cang Jiumin by the skin of his teeth. Meanwhile, Gongye Wuji grows curious about his complicated past.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: A ritual designed to help Susu takes a disastrous turn as a cunning man exposes his true colors. Jiumin has no choice but to face a demonic illusion.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Amidst mounting wrath from all the sects, Cang Jiumin attempts to make the ultimate sacrifice. A power-hungry Dimian decides to risk everything.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: In control of Dimian's body, the demon lord crushes one challenger after another. However, everything changes with the arrival of Cang Jiumin.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: An emotional confrontation pushes Tantai Jin to reclaim his destiny. Shortly after, he takes Susu on a trip down memory lane.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Two star-crossed lovers exchange their one last toast. As the world hangs on the brink of destruction, Susu finally grasps what Tantai Jin truly wants.
